# ASPEC Individual Contributor Agreement

**Version 1.0**

This Individual Contributor Agreement (the **Agreement**) is between you, the individual identified by the GitHub account that accepts it (**You**), and **ASPEC RACING PTY LTD** (ABN 41 676 208 227), an Australian proprietary company (**ASPEC**, **We** or **Us**).

It covers every Contribution You Submit to any project that ASPEC owns or manages and that refers to this Agreement (each a **Project**). Under this Agreement You assign the copyright in Your Contributions to ASPEC, and ASPEC licenses Your Contributions back to You so that You can keep using them.

## 1. Definitions

1.1 **Contribution** means any original work of authorship that You Submit to a Project, including source code, documentation, designs, images and other material, together with any changes to existing material. Something You mark clearly in writing as "Not a Contribution" at the time You Submit it is excluded.

1.2 **Submit** means to send or communicate to ASPEC or a Project in any form, electronic, verbal or written. This includes pull requests, commits, patches, issue trackers, mailing lists and chat systems that ASPEC manages or uses for a Project.

1.3 **Copyright** means all copyright and related rights in any jurisdiction, including rights in databases and neighbouring rights, now existing or later arising, and including future copyright.

1.4 **Patent Claims** means any patent claims that You own or control now or later, and that would be infringed by making, using, selling or otherwise dealing in Your Contribution, alone or combined with the Project it was Submitted to.

1.5 **Effective Date** means the date You accept this Agreement.

1.6 **Existing Contribution** means a Contribution You Submitted to a Project before the Effective Date.

1.7 **Submission Date** means, for a Contribution, the date it was Submitted.

## 2. Assignment and licences

2.1 **Assignment.** You assign to ASPEC all Your right, title and interest in the Copyright in each Contribution, including each Existing Contribution. For Contributions not yet made, this is an assignment of future copyright for the purposes of section 197 of the *Copyright Act 1968* (Cth) and corresponding laws elsewhere, and the Copyright vests in ASPEC when the Contribution comes into existence. ASPEC accepts the assignment.

2.2 **Licence back to You.** ASPEC grants You a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, non-exclusive, royalty-free licence under the Copyright in each of Your Contributions to use, reproduce, modify, distribute and otherwise deal with that Contribution for any purpose, including commercial purposes. You may sublicense this licence, but You may not grant anyone an exclusive licence in a Contribution or assign this licence. This licence covers Your Contributions alone. It gives You no rights in the rest of a Project.

2.3 **Fallback licence.** If the assignment in clause 2.1 is not effective for any Contribution, in any jurisdiction or for any reason, You grant ASPEC a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, exclusive (except for the licence in clause 2.2 and any licence that applied to an Existing Contribution before the Effective Date), royalty-free and fee-free licence under the Copyright in that Contribution. ASPEC may transfer it and sublicense it through multiple tiers. It covers every act that the owner of the Copyright could do or authorise, in any form or medium, whether now known or developed later. If the licence cannot be exclusive under the applicable law, it is non-exclusive.

2.4 **Outbound licensing.** ASPEC may license, sublicense or distribute any Contribution, and any work that includes it, under any terms ASPEC chooses. These include open-source, source-available, proprietary and commercial licences, with or without charge. However, if ASPEC includes a Contribution in any work that it makes available to third parties, ASPEC will also license the Contribution under the licence or licences that applied to the Project on the Submission Date, in addition to any other terms it chooses.

2.5 **Patent licence.** You grant ASPEC, and everyone who receives a Project or Contribution from ASPEC directly or indirectly, a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, non-exclusive, royalty-free licence under Your Patent Claims. It allows them to make, have made, use, sell, offer to sell, import and otherwise transfer the Contribution, and the Project combined with it. ASPEC may sublicense and transfer this licence.

2.6 **Moral rights.** If You are an author, You give Your genuine and informed written consent, for the purposes of Part IX of the *Copyright Act 1968* (Cth) and corresponding laws elsewhere, to ASPEC and its licensees and successors doing or omitting any act in relation to Your Contributions. This includes using them without attribution, with attribution to others, or in altered or adapted form. The consent is given to the extent permitted by law and covers acts and omissions both before and after the date of this consent. Where consent is not enough under the applicable law, You waive Your moral rights to the extent the law permits, and agree not to assert them against those persons.

2.7 **Limited waiver of claims.** You agree not to make any claim against ASPEC, its licensees or its successors that arises from the exercise of the rights given to them by this Agreement in Your Contributions. This waiver covers only Your Contributions and the rights given under this Agreement. It does not affect any other claim You may have, any claim about material that is not Your Contribution, or Your rights under clause 2.2 or clause 2.4.

2.8 **Existing Contributions.** The assignment, licences and consents in this clause 2 apply to Existing Contributions and are irrevocable for them.

2.9 **No obligation.** ASPEC does not have to use, include or distribute any Contribution.

2.10 **Reserved rights.** You keep all rights not expressly assigned or granted in this Agreement.

## 3. Your confirmations

You confirm that:

(a) You have the legal capacity and authority to enter into this Agreement and are at least 18 years old. If You are under 18, a parent or legal guardian must accept on Your behalf.

(b) Each Contribution is Your original work, or You otherwise have enough rights to make the assignment and grant the licences in clause 2.

(c) You have not granted, and will not grant, rights in any Contribution that conflict with this Agreement. If an employer or anyone else may have rights in a Contribution under an employment contract, contractor agreement or the law (for example s 35(6) of the *Copyright Act 1968* (Cth)), You have either obtained their written permission to Submit it under this Agreement or that party has signed the ASPEC Entity Contributor Agreement covering You.

(d) If any part of a Contribution is not Your original work (for example third-party code), You will identify it when You Submit it. That includes its source, any licence or other restrictions that apply, and any facts You know that might affect ASPEC's rights. Clause 2.1 does not assign Copyright in material You do not own.

(e) You will tell ASPEC promptly if You become aware that any of these confirmations is no longer accurate.

## 4. Ending future contributions and removal

4.1 **Ending this Agreement for future Contributions.** You may end this Agreement at any time by written notice to legal@aspecracing.com.au. It then stops applying to Contributions You Submit after ASPEC receives the notice. Ending it does not affect any Contribution Submitted before then. For those Contributions, the assignment, licences, consents and waiver in clause 2 continue permanently.

4.2 **Removal.** ASPEC may remove any Contribution from a Project at any time, at its discretion. You may ask ASPEC in writing to remove a Contribution, for example because You believe a confirmation in clause 3 was wrong. ASPEC will consider the request in good faith, but deciding whether to remove the Contribution is for ASPEC alone. Removal does not affect the rights in clause 2, or any copies or versions already distributed.

## 5. Disclaimer and liability

5.1 **Disclaimer.** Apart from the confirmations in clause 3, each Contribution is provided "as is". Subject to clause 6.7, You give no other warranties or conditions, express or implied, including any of merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose or non-infringement.

5.2 **Limitation of liability.** Subject to clause 6.7, neither party is liable to the other under this Agreement for any indirect or consequential loss, or for loss of profit, revenue or data, however it arises. This does not limit liability for breach of clause 3, or for fraud or wilful misconduct.

## 6. General

6.1 **Electronic signature and records.** You may accept this Agreement electronically, either through the signing page ASPEC provides after You sign in with Your GitHub account, or by posting the acceptance statement required by ASPEC from Your authenticated GitHub account. You agree that Your electronic acceptance, including a typed or drawn signature, identifies You, shows Your intention to be bound and is Your signature on this Agreement in writing. That includes the purposes of section 196(3) of the *Copyright Act 1968* (Cth), the *Electronic Transactions Act 1999* (Cth) and corresponding State and Territory laws. ASPEC will keep a record of Your acceptance. The record includes Your GitHub account ID, the time of acceptance, the version and text of this Agreement, Your signature and the network address it was made from. ASPEC will give You a copy.

6.2 **Further assurance.** If ASPEC asks, You will sign any further document reasonably needed to confirm or register the assignment in clause 2.1, at ASPEC's cost.

6.3 **Consideration.** You enter into this Agreement in exchange for ASPEC considering Your Contributions for inclusion in a Project and for the licence in clause 2.2.

6.4 **Governing law.** The laws of Victoria, Australia, govern this Agreement. Its conflict-of-laws rules do not apply, and neither does the United Nations Convention on Contracts for the International Sale of Goods. Each party submits to the non-exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of that State and the courts that can hear appeals from them.

6.5 **Entire agreement.** This Agreement is the whole agreement between the parties about its subject matter.

6.6 **Assignment of this Agreement.** ASPEC may assign or novate this Agreement, or any rights under it, to any person without Your consent. Any successor takes it subject to clauses 2.2 and 2.4. You may not assign it without ASPEC's written consent.

6.7 **Non-excludable rights.** Nothing in this Agreement excludes, restricts or modifies any right or remedy, or any guarantee, warranty or other term or condition, implied or imposed by law (including the *Australian Consumer Law*) that cannot lawfully be excluded or limited.

6.8 **Severability and waiver.** If any provision is invalid or unenforceable, it is read down to the minimum extent needed, or severed, and the rest of the Agreement continues in effect. A failure or delay in exercising a right is not a waiver.

6.9 **Versions.** This version of the Agreement does not change after You accept it. ASPEC may publish new versions, but a new version applies to You only if You accept it.
